name: Falafel
assumptions: Yield estimated from explicit instruction to mould mixture into 6 balls/patties; typical single-serving falafel count.
Total time is sum of explicit instruction times (5 min fry onion/garlic + 6 min fry falafels) plus ~14 min estimated for mashing, mixing, seasoning, shaping (standard for this style of recipe).
No wheat, gluten-containing grains, dairy, fish, shellfish, tree nuts or peanuts appear in ingredients list.
Sesame left null because tahini or sesame seeds are common in falafel but not listed here; ambiguous without explicit absence.

Recipe is vegetarian per explicit egg use and source label; not vegan due to egg; pescatarian incompatible with no fish but presence of egg in some definitions; gluten-free and dairy-free compatible with listed ingredients.
instructions:
step 1
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan, then fry the onion and garlic over a low heat for 5 mins until softened. Tip into a large mixing bowl with the chickpeas and spices, then mash together with a fork or potato masher until the chickpeas are totally broken down. Stir in the parsley or dried herbs, with seasoning to taste. Add the egg, then squish the mixture together with your hands.

step 2
Mould the mix into 6 balls, then flatten into patties. Heat the remaining oil in the pan, then fry the falafels on a medium heat for 3 mins on each side, until golden brown and firm. Serve hot or cold with couscous, pitta bread or salad.
